description: This file contains table utilities and row/column manipulation operations for Feishu documents, including adaptive column width calculation, block cleaning for API compatibility, and table editing functions such as insert, delete, and merge operations.

methods.name: calculateAdaptiveColumnWidths
methods.description: Calculates adaptive column widths based on cell content length, considering CJK characters, for a specific table block.

methods.name: cleanBlocksForDescendant
methods.description: Prepares and cleans blocks for Descendant API, removing read-only fields and applying adaptive column widths.

methods.name: insertTableRow
methods.description: Inserts a new row into a table at a specified index.

methods.name: insertTableColumn
methods.description: Inserts a new column into a table at a specified index.

methods.name: deleteTableRows
methods.description: Deletes a specified number of rows starting from a given index.

methods.name: deleteTableColumns
methods.description: Deletes a specified number of columns starting from a given index.

methods.name: mergeTableCells
methods.description: Merges a range of table cells specified by start and end row/column indices.
